WITH user_age AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age('2026-04-16'::DATE, TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE))) AS age
    FROM log.main.mst_users
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s'
        WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_age
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH user_age AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(TRY_CAST(register_date AS DATE), TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE))) AS age
    FROM log.main.mst_users
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s'
        WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_age
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH user_age AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age('2026-04-16'::DATE, TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE))) AS age
    FROM log.main.mst_users
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s'
        WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_age
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log.main.mst_users WHERE birth_date IS NULL;

WITH user_age AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age('2026-04-16'::DATE, TRY_CAST(birth_date AS DATE))) AS age
    FROM log.main.mst_users
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s'
        WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s'
        WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s'
        WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s'
        ELSE 'others'
    END AS age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_age
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 
    CASE age_category
        WHEN '20s' THEN 1
        WHEN '30s' THEN 2
        WHEN '40s' THEN 3
        WHEN '50s' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END;
